dimensions.assessment: Provides specific legal authorization for National Guard personnel on duty under title 10 or title 32 to counter unmanned aircraft threats at protected events and facilities.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes operational duties for existing military forces; no separate funding appropriations are stated.
Amends the Homeland Security Act of 2002, title 10, and title 32 of the U.S. Code to expand operational authorities for the National Guard.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Homeland Security Act of 2002 and titles 10 and 32, United States Code, to authorize the National Guard to protect certain facilities and assets from unmanned aircraft

dimensions.assessment: Creates permanent statutory authorizations for National Guard mission execution.

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or funding allocations for carrying out the unmanned aircraft protection missions.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Homeland Security Act of 2002 and titles 10 and 32 to authorize the National Guard to protect specific facilities and assets from unmanned aircraft upon request from a state's chief executive officer.
